notes: Posted 30 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Credited to Tom Hollingworth: the byline is Brian "vader106" Hollingworth, but the strategy says 'this is Tom, not Brian, Hollingworth submitting the deck' because Tom had no account.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (9)': SYCFA (Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe), Death Star, Alderaan, DSDB (Death Star: Docking Bay 327), Start Your Engines!, Podrace Arena, Sebulba's (Sebulba's Podracer), Podrace (Boonta Eve Podrace) and Watto's Box; they count toward the total.

Systems and sites dested the Dark pages: Alderaan (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Endor (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark); 'DSWar Room' = Death Star: War Room.

Posted 'Podrace' dested Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark); 'Emperor' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Zuckuss in ship' / 'Bossk in ship' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter / Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Omni Box combo' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Twi'ilek Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor.
Come Here You Big Coward and Secret Plans are 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).
Total is 59 as published (the section counts 9+4+12+9+17+6+2 add up to 59).
